headline: For migration specifically, timing determines the better choice
summary: The Serengeti and Masai Mara are the same ecosystem; the migration moves between them seasonally. For migration viewing: the Mara is better July-October when herds are crossing the Mara River; the Serengeti is better November-June when herds are in various Serengeti regions. The Serengeti offers migration for more months of the year; the Mara offers a more concentrated crossing season.

assumptions.text: Serengeti and Mara are one continuous ecosystem divided by a political border.
The Mara has migration herds and river crossings primarily July-October.
The Serengeti hosts migration for more months across different regions.

gains: Mara (Jul-Oct): Concentrated crossing season, off-road driving
Mara: Smaller area means less searching for herds
Serengeti (Nov-Jun): Migration across more months and regions
Serengeti: Combine with Ngorongoro, less crowded than Mara
losses: Mara: On-road only in some conservancies
Serengeti: On-road only in national park
Serengeti: Requires correct region positioning by month

change_conditions: If traveling July-October, the Mara offers river crossings and concentrated herds.
If traveling November-June, the Serengeti is the only option for migration.
If off-road driving is essential, the Mara or Tanzania conservancies work.
If combining with other Tanzania destinations, Serengeti fits better logistically.
